payload.title: frick-codegen as the canonical artifact generator (retire pnpm schema:generate)
payload.description: frick-codegen produces byte-identical Swift/Kotlin/TS DTOs (snapshot-tested) but pnpm schema:generate (TS, in packages/protocol) is still the canonical generator that writes the tracked artifacts + drives verify:generated. Wire frick-codegen (e.g. via `frick schema generate` writing to the artifact paths) as the source of truth and retire the TS generation pipeline.
